Simulation Launch Files

sim_complete_bringup.launch.py

Starts the complete simulation with navigation.

 1"""
 2Launch file for the complete Mensabot simulation system.
 3
 4This launch file starts the complete software stack required for autonomous
 5operation in simulation. It sequentially launches the simulated robot,
 6localization and the Nav2 navigation stack to ensure that all required
 7components are initialized in the correct order.
 8
 9The staged startup prevents initialization conflicts by delaying the
10localization and navigation components until the simulation environment is
11fully available.
12"""
13
14import os
15from launch import LaunchDescription
16from launch.actions import IncludeLaunchDescription, TimerAction
17from launch.launch_description_sources import PythonLaunchDescriptionSource
18from ament_index_python.packages import get_package_share_directory
19
20
21def generate_launch_description():
22    """
23    Create the launch description for the complete simulation system.
24
25    The launch description first starts the simulated robot environment, followed
26    by delayed initialization of the localization and navigation components to
27    ensure a reliable startup sequence.
28
29    Returns:
30        LaunchDescription: Launch description for the complete simulated robot
31        system.
32    """
33
34    pkg_mensabot_bringup = get_package_share_directory(
35        'mensabot_bringup'
36    )
37
38    sim_bringup_launch = IncludeLaunchDescription(
39        PythonLaunchDescriptionSource(
40            os.path.join(
41                pkg_mensabot_bringup,
42                'launch/Simulation',
43                'sim_bringup_robot.launch.py'
44            )
45        )
46    )
47
48    localization_launch = IncludeLaunchDescription(
49        PythonLaunchDescriptionSource(
50            os.path.join(
51                pkg_mensabot_bringup,
52                'launch/Simulation',
53                'localization_sim_amcl.launch.py'
54            )
55        )
56    )
57
58    navigation_launch = IncludeLaunchDescription(
59        PythonLaunchDescriptionSource(
60            os.path.join(
61                pkg_mensabot_bringup,
62                'launch/Simulation',
63                'navigation_sim.launch.py'
64            )
65        )
66    )
67
68    delayed_localization = TimerAction(
69        period=3.0,
70        actions=[
71            localization_launch
72        ]
73    )
74
75    delayed_navigation = TimerAction(
76        period=6.0,
77        actions=[
78            navigation_launch
79        ]
80    )
81
82    return LaunchDescription([
83        sim_bringup_launch,
84        delayed_localization,
85        delayed_navigation,
86    ])

sim_bringup_robot.launch.py

Starts the simulation without localization and navigation.

  1"""
  2Launch file for the Mensabot simulation environment.
  3
  4This launch file initializes the complete simulated robot system, including
  5the Gazebo simulation environment, robot model, ros2_control, localization,
  6sensor processing, safety functions and supporting utility nodes.
  7
  8The simulated robot is spawned into the selected Gazebo world and all required
  9ROS 2 interfaces are initialized for autonomous navigation and testing.
 10
 11Launch Arguments:
 12    world (str):
 13        Path to the Gazebo world file.
 14
 15    model (str):
 16        Robot description (URDF/Xacro) file.
 17
 18    x (float):
 19        Initial x-coordinate of the spawned robot.
 20
 21    y (float):
 22        Initial y-coordinate of the spawned robot.
 23
 24    yaw (float):
 25        Initial heading of the spawned robot.
 26
 27    use_sim_time (bool):
 28        Enables simulation time provided by Gazebo.
 29"""
 30
 31import os
 32from launch import LaunchDescription
 33from launch.actions import DeclareLaunchArgument, IncludeLaunchDescription
 34from launch.launch_description_sources import PythonLaunchDescriptionSource
 35from launch.substitutions import LaunchConfiguration, PathJoinSubstitution, Command
 36from launch_ros.actions import ComposableNodeContainer, Node
 37from launch_ros.descriptions import ComposableNode
 38from ament_index_python.packages import get_package_share_directory
 39
 40def generate_launch_description():
 41    """
 42    Create the launch description for the simulated robot platform.
 43
 44    The launch description starts the Gazebo world, spawns the robot model,
 45    initializes ros2_control, localization, sensor processing, safety functions
 46    and all supporting utility nodes required for operating the robot in
 47    simulation.
 48
 49    Returns:
 50        LaunchDescription: Complete launch description for the simulated robot.
 51    """
 52
 53    pkg_mensabot_description = get_package_share_directory('mensabot_description')
 54    pkg_mensabot_bringup = get_package_share_directory('mensabot_bringup')
 55    pkg_mensabot_simulation = get_package_share_directory('mensabot_simulation')
 56    pkg_mensabot_navigation = get_package_share_directory('mensabot_navigation')    
 57    pkg_laser_scan_merger = get_package_share_directory('laser_scan_merger')
 58
 59    world_arg = DeclareLaunchArgument(
 60        'world',
 61        default_value=os.path.join(
 62            pkg_mensabot_simulation,
 63            'worlds',
 64            'world_room.sdf'
 65        ),
 66        description='Full path to the Gazebo world file'
 67    )
 68
 69    model_arg = DeclareLaunchArgument(
 70        'model',
 71        default_value='mensabot.urdf.xacro',
 72    )
 73
 74    x_arg = DeclareLaunchArgument(
 75        'x', default_value='0.0',
 76        description='x coordinate of spawned robot'
 77    )
 78
 79    y_arg = DeclareLaunchArgument(
 80        'y', default_value='0.0',
 81        description='y coordinate of spawned robot'
 82    )
 83
 84    yaw_arg = DeclareLaunchArgument(
 85        'yaw', default_value='0.0',
 86        description='yaw angle of spawned robot'
 87    )
 88
 89    sim_time_arg = DeclareLaunchArgument(
 90        'use_sim_time', default_value='True',
 91        description='Flag to enable use_sim_time'
 92    )
 93
 94    # Define the path to your URDF or Xacro file
 95    urdf_file_path = PathJoinSubstitution([
 96        pkg_mensabot_description,  # Replace with your package name
 97        "urdf",
 98        LaunchConfiguration('model')  # Replace with your URDF or Xacro file
 99    ])
100
101    gz_bridge_params_path = os.path.join(
102        pkg_mensabot_simulation,
103        'config',
104        'gz_bridge.yaml'
105    )
106
107    world_launch = IncludeLaunchDescription(
108        PythonLaunchDescriptionSource(
109            os.path.join(pkg_mensabot_simulation, 'launch', 'world.launch.py'),
110        ),
111        launch_arguments={
112            'world': LaunchConfiguration('world'),
113        }.items()
114    )
115
116    # Spawn the URDF model using the /world/<world_name>/create service
117    spawn_urdf_node = Node(
118        package="ros_gz_sim",
119        executable="create",
120        arguments=[
121            "-name", "mensabot",
122            "-topic", "robot_description",
123            "-x", LaunchConfiguration('x'), "-y", LaunchConfiguration('y'), "-z", "0.5", "-Y", LaunchConfiguration('yaw')  # Initial spawn position
124        ],
125        output="screen",
126        parameters=[
127            {'use_sim_time': LaunchConfiguration('use_sim_time')},
128        ]
129    )
130
131    # Node to bridge /cmd_vel and /odom
132    gz_bridge_node = Node(
133        package="ros_gz_bridge",
134        executable="parameter_bridge",
135        arguments=[
136            '--ros-args', '-p',
137            f'config_file:={gz_bridge_params_path}'
138        ],
139        output="screen",
140        parameters=[
141            {'use_sim_time': LaunchConfiguration('use_sim_time')},
142        ]
143    )
144
145    robot_state_publisher_node = Node(
146        package='robot_state_publisher',
147        executable='robot_state_publisher',
148        name='robot_state_publisher',
149        output='screen',
150        parameters=[
151            {'robot_description': Command(['xacro', ' ', urdf_file_path, ' use_sim:=true']),
152             'use_sim_time': LaunchConfiguration('use_sim_time')},
153        ],
154    )
155
156    joint_state_broadcaster_node = Node(
157        package='controller_manager',
158        executable='spawner',
159        name='joint_state_broadcaster_spawner',
160        arguments=['joint_state_broadcaster', '--controller-manager', '/controller_manager'],
161        output='screen',
162        parameters=[
163            {'use_sim_time': LaunchConfiguration('use_sim_time')},
164        ]
165    )
166
167    diff_drive_controller_node = Node(
168        package='controller_manager',
169        executable='spawner',
170        arguments=[
171            'mensabot_base_controller',
172            '--controller-manager', '/controller_manager'
173        ],
174        parameters=[{'use_sim_time': LaunchConfiguration('use_sim_time')}],
175        output='screen',
176    )
177
178    ekf_node = Node(
179        package='robot_localization',
180        executable='ekf_node',
181        name='ekf_filter_node',
182        output='screen',
183        remappings=[('/odometry/filtered', '/odom')],   # Remap the output of the EKF to /odom instead of /odometry/filtered like default
184        parameters=[
185            os.path.join(pkg_mensabot_bringup, 'config', 'ekf.yaml'),
186            {'use_sim_time': LaunchConfiguration('use_sim_time')},
187             ]
188    )
189
190    cmd_vel_transform_node = Node(
191        package='mensabot_utils',
192        executable='cmd_vel_transform',
193        name='cmd_vel_transform_node',
194        output='screen'
195    )
196
197    safety_control_node = Node(
198        package='mensabot_utils',
199        executable='safety_control_node',
200        name='safety_control_node',
201        parameters=[{'simulation': True}],
202        output='screen'
203    )
204
205    simulation_publisher_node = Node(
206        package='mensabot_utils',
207        executable='simulation_publisher_node',
208        name='simulation_publisher_node',
209        output='screen'
210    )
211
212    laser_scan_merger_node = ComposableNodeContainer(
213        package="rclcpp_components",
214        executable="component_container",
215        name="component_manager_node",
216        namespace="",
217        composable_node_descriptions=[
218            ComposableNode(
219                package="laser_scan_merger",
220                plugin="util::LaserScanMerger",
221                name="laser_scan_merger_node",
222                parameters=[
223                    os.path.join(pkg_laser_scan_merger, 'config', 'laser_merger_param.yaml'),
224                    {'use_sim_time': LaunchConfiguration('use_sim_time')},
225                ]
226            )
227        ],
228        output="screen"
229    )
230
231    lidar_field_selection_node = Node(
232        package='mensabot_utils',
233        executable='lidar_field_selection_node',
234        name='lidar_field_selection_node',
235        parameters=[{'simulation': True}],
236        output='screen'
237    )
238
239    laser_scan_matcher_node = Node(
240                package='rf2o_laser_odometry',
241                executable='rf2o_laser_odometry_node',
242                name='rf2o_laser_odometry',
243                output='screen',
244                parameters=[{
245                    'laser_scan_topic' : '/merged_scan',
246                    'odom_topic' : '/odom_rf2o',
247                    'publish_tf' : False,
248                    'base_frame_id' : 'base_link',
249                    'odom_frame_id' : 'odom',
250                    'init_pose_from_topic' : '',
251                    'freq' : 5.0}],
252    )
253
254    launchDescriptionObject = LaunchDescription()
255
256    launchDescriptionObject.add_action(world_arg)
257    launchDescriptionObject.add_action(model_arg)
258    launchDescriptionObject.add_action(x_arg)
259    launchDescriptionObject.add_action(y_arg)
260    launchDescriptionObject.add_action(yaw_arg)
261    launchDescriptionObject.add_action(sim_time_arg)
262    launchDescriptionObject.add_action(world_launch)
263    launchDescriptionObject.add_action(spawn_urdf_node)
264    launchDescriptionObject.add_action(gz_bridge_node)
265    launchDescriptionObject.add_action(robot_state_publisher_node)
266    launchDescriptionObject.add_action(joint_state_broadcaster_node)
267    launchDescriptionObject.add_action(diff_drive_controller_node)
268    launchDescriptionObject.add_action(ekf_node)
269    launchDescriptionObject.add_action(cmd_vel_transform_node)
270    launchDescriptionObject.add_action(safety_control_node)
271    launchDescriptionObject.add_action(simulation_publisher_node)
272    launchDescriptionObject.add_action(laser_scan_merger_node)
273    launchDescriptionObject.add_action(lidar_field_selection_node)
274    launchDescriptionObject.add_action(laser_scan_matcher_node)
275    
276    return launchDescriptionObject
